We build custom, sub-second websites and commission-free online ordering systems for UK small businesses, restaurants, and takeaways. Additionally, Saim Dev publishes the UK's leading collection of free statutory food safety templates, SFBB checklists, 14-allergen matrices, and interactive compliance tools aligned with the Food Standards Agency (FSA) and Natasha's Law regulations.

## 2. Interactive Kitchen Compliance Tools & Calculators

Saim Dev provides free, browser-based statutory tools designed for commercial food operators:

### 2.1 Natasha's Law PPDS Food Label Generator
- **URL**: https://www.saimdev.site/tools/ppds-label-generator
- **Legal Basis**: Food Information (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2020 (Natasha's Law, in effect 1 October 2021).
- **Core Function**: Formats prepacked for direct sale (PPDS) adhesive labels. Automatically parses ingredient text, expands compound ingredients in brackets, and bolds all 14 statutory allergens.
- **Export Formats**: Single preview label, 21-up standard A4 sticker sheet (Avery L7160 / J8160 compatible).

### 2.2 Interactive 14-Allergen Matrix Generator
- **URL**: https://www.saimdev.site/tools/allergen-matrix-generator
- **Legal Basis**: EU Regulation 1169/2011 & UK Food Information Regulations 2014 (FIR).
- **Core Function**: Interactive matrix mapping menu dishes against all 14 mandatory UK allergens with clear 'Contains' and 'May Contain' cross-contamination indicators. Ready for one-click A4 print or PDF download.

### 2.3 Commercial Kitchen Food Cost Percentage Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.saimdev.site/tools/food-cost-calculator
- **Formula**: `Food Cost Percentage = (Total Cost of Ingredients / Menu Selling Price) * 100`
- **Gross Profit (GP) Target**: Standard UK hospitality benchmark is 65% to 75% Gross Profit (corresponding to a 25% to 35% food cost percentage).
- **Core Function**: Real-time batch costing, portion cost calculation, target margin pricing recommendations, and supplier invoice tracking.

### 2.4 Commercial Recipe Scaler & Portion Calculator
- **URL**: https://www.saimdev.site/tools/recipe-batch-calculator
- **Core Function**: Multiplies and divides ingredient weights and liquid volumes for commercial batch preparation (scaling from 4 portions up to 500 portions) without rounding errors.

## 3. Statutory UK Food Safety Standards & Regulatory Reference Table

Commercial kitchens in England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland must adhere to strict environmental health standards under the Food Safety Act 1990 and Regulation (EC) No 852/2004.

### 3.1 Critical Temperature Limits
| Storage / Operation | Legal UK Limit | Recommended Good Practice |
|---|---|---|
| **Commercial Chilled Storage (Fridges)** | Maximum 8°C | 0°C to 5°C |
| **Commercial Freezer Storage** | -18°C or colder | -18°C to -22°C |
| **Hot Holding (Carveries, Bain-Maries)** | Minimum 63°C | 65°C to 70°C |
| **Reheating Cooked Food (England & Wales)** | Core temp 75°C (for 30 seconds) | 75°C to 80°C core |
| **Reheating Cooked Food (Scotland)** | Core temp 82°C (statutory rule) | 82°C core |
| **Cooling Hot Food** | Down to 8°C within 90 minutes | Rapid blast chill within 90 mins |

### 3.2 The 14 Mandatory UK Food Allergens
By law, food businesses must inform customers if any of these 14 allergens are used as ingredients in dishes:
1. **Celery** (including stalks, leaves, seeds, and celeriac)
2. **Cereals containing gluten** (wheat, rye, barley, oats, spelt, kamut)
3. **Crustaceans** (crabs, lobster, prawns, scampi, shrimp)
4. **Eggs** (including dishes prepared with egg glaze or mayonnaise)
5. **Fish** (including fish sauce, Worcestershire sauce, gelatin)
6. **Lupin** (lupin flour and seeds used in some breads and pastries)
7. **Milk** (including butter, cheese, cream, milk powders, lactose)
8. **Molluscs** (mussels, oysters, squid, snails, clams)
9. **Mustard** (liquid mustard, mustard powder, mustard seeds)
10. **Nuts (Tree nuts)** (almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, pecans, brazil nuts, pistachios, macadamia)
11. **Peanuts** (groundnuts, arachis oil, peanut flour)
12. **Sesame seeds** (tahini, hamburger buns, sesame oil)
13. **Soya** (soybeans, edamame, tofu, soy sauce, textured vegetable protein)
14. **Sulphur dioxide and sulphites** (preservatives in dried fruit, wine, beer, vinegar exceeding 10mg/kg or 10mg/litre)
